description.en: Zero-download QQ bot channel plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Pure Node with no npm dependencies or installs, it provides an in-panel direct-chat test that runs the full BotLogic pipeline immediately with no QQ client and no API key (Harness-native model by default), automatically discovers local OneBot ports by scanning common forward-WebSocket ports and auto-connects when none is configured (never overwriting a manual URL, always excluding its own reverse-WS port), optionally connects out to an already-running OneBot v11 forward WebSocket or accepts reverse WebSocket / HTTP POST from any existing OneBot implementation, receives images and answers questions, and keeps per-session long-term memory.
description.zh: 零下载的 DeepSeek Harness QQ 机器人通道插件：纯 Node、无 npm 依赖、不下载不安装任何 QQ 客户端，启用后即可在面板「① 直聊测试」里直接走完整的收图、模型作答、记忆与分段回复流程（无需 QQ 客户端、无需密钥，默认跟随 Harness 原生模型）；新增「本机 OneBot 端口自动探测 + 自动连接」——自动扫描本机常见正向 WebSocket 端口并自动连上（无需填地址、不覆盖手工配置、自身反向 WS 端口始终排除）；如需连接真实 QQ，也可选填一个已经装好并正在运行的 OneBot v11 正向 WebSocket 地址，或让任意已有 OneBot 实现以反向 WebSocket / HTTP POST 连回本插件；支持接收图片答题与按会话隔离的长期记忆。
